metadata.title: On the type of a complex hyperbolic triangle group
metadata.abstract: In this paper we consider groups of complex hyperbolic isometries generated by three complex involutions. Our first main result states that if the group is discrete and at least two of the mirrors of complex reflections intersect, then the group may be put into a normal form involving the ordering of traces of short, even length words. Our second main result refines a conjecture of Schwartz (proved by Grossi) that determines the type of the group in terms of the angles between the mirrors. That is, in the parameter space of complex triangles with given angles, it determines which of two given words becomes elliptic first.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 复双曲三角群的类型判据
analysis.workSummary: 对由三个复 involution 生成的离散群，在至少两个 mirror 相交时，以短偶字 trace 排序给出 normal form；进一步细化固定 mirror 角参数下两个指定字谁先成为 elliptic 的类型判据。
analysis.breakthrough: 细化复双曲三角群参数空间的类型边界。
analysis.limitations: normal form 保留离散与 mirror 相交条件；类型判据不是所有参数下离散性的完整刻画。
